title: docs(skills): objectstack-ai teaches the unknown-key refusal for the two retired agent keys
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLCo5F2y7fgbM8tstGoyyUn)_

Fixes #37782

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：照着 AI 技能文档写智能体的人，读到「两个已下线旧字段」那段说明时，看到的是现在真实的行为：系统把它们当未知字段拒绝，并指向升级指南网页。原文说的「带迁移提示的专用报错」和「迁移会自动删除该字段」都已不存在，这次一并改正。
- 为什么做：技能文档与平台实际行为对齐的收尾，去掉一段过期描述、表格里一句过期说法和两处指向空处的引用。
- 出错会怎样：只改了说明文字，实际报错不受影响；写错的话读者只会对报错形式有错误预期，撤回这次改动即可恢复。
- 要你做什么：这是对外发布的技能文档，席位审核通过后请你批准合并。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the paragraph above the retired-key table, the table's header cell, and one clause of the `agent.tools` row. Nothing else in the file moves.

- Paragraph, before: "Two `AgentSchema` keys are **tombstones**, not legacy options — authoring either is a parse error carrying its migration (`packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:234, :251`)". On `main`, lines 234 and 251 of that file hold a type export and a memory-store constant, and the file declares no `tools` or `knowledge` key and no `retiredKey()` for either.
- Paragraph, after: "Two `AgentSchema` keys are retired, not legacy options: the strict schema refuses each as an unknown key, naming https://objectstack.ai/docs/protocol-upgrade:". The citation is the strict-object refusal itself, stated in words. No line number is left to drift.
- Header cell: "REMOVED in protocol 17" becomes "Removed in 17, tombstone gone in 18".
- `agent.tools` row, one clause, before: "Not a rename: the migration deletes the key and names each tool that was listed; re-declare each in a `defineSkill` under the stack's `skills` (ADR-0064)". After: "Not a rename: the strict schema refuses the key as unknown; re-declare each tool in a `defineSkill` under the stack's `skills` (ADR-0064)". The `agent-tools-to-skills` conversion left the load path in `@objectstack/spec` 17.0.0 (`packages/spec/src/conversions/retired-after.census.json`), so no migration converts the key any more. The row's why-sentence and its replacement stay as PR #37797 landed them. The L1 (7218142210) and contract review (7218120173) of #37797 both carried this clause here.
- The `agent.knowledge` row is untouched.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` row is lowered 6795 to 6791, the file's measurement on this head, with a one-line note. A lowering, not a raise; no other row moves.
- A patch changeset for `@objectstack/skills` carries the two declaration lines and names the clause.

Head `873d3a6d` merges `main` after PR #37797 (`3247e87d`) with no conflict, then rewrites the clause and lowers the row.

Skill length (tokens as the ratchet counts them):

| | before (`main`) | after (`873d3a6d`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` | 486 lines, 6795 tokens (27207 bytes) | 486 lines, 6791 tokens (27191 bytes) |

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the "Two `AgentSchema` keys" paragraph and the `agent.tools` row: check each claim against the tests named under Tests.
2. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, the one row: 6795 to 6791 and its note.
3. `.changeset/37782-ai-skill-retired-agent-keys-refusal.md`.

## Tests

No test changes: the diff is prose in a published skill, a ratchet row and a changeset. The behaviour the text describes is already pinned on `main` in `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.test.ts`:

- describe `agent.tools retirement (ADR-0064) — aged out; tools move into skills`, test "REFUSES a legacy inline tools array as an unknown key naming the upgrade guide".
- describe `AgentSchema`, group `Tools and Capabilities`, test "the refusal is the strict unknown-key one, naming the guide where the scoping prescription lives" (asserts `unrecognized_keys`, the key name `knowledge` and the guide URL).

`AgentSchema` is built with `strictObject` in `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts`; the URL is `PROTOCOL_UPGRADE_GUIDE_URL` in `packages/spec/src/shared/protocol-upgrade-guide.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- The card and the dispatch name an `agent.knowledge` describe in `agent.test.ts`. There is none on `main`: the `knowledge` refusal is pinned by the two tests in `AgentSchema` / `Tools and Capabilities`. The paragraph cites no describe name, so nothing depends on it.
- "Removed in 17" is kept as a fact: `content/docs/ai/tools.mdx` on `main` says `agent.tools` was removed in protocol 17, and the comments in `agent.test.ts` say both tombstones left the shape at 18.
- The same file cites `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:87-95` in its Model Configuration section. Those lines still hold the keys it names (the range has drifted by a few lines). Outside this card's paragraph, not touched.
- Overlap at `873d3a6d`: `main` merges cleanly; PR 37919 and PR 37661 merge cleanly. PR 37947, PR 37937 and PR 36158 each conflict with this branch only in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, at the lowered row (`SKILL.md` merges by text with all of them). Whichever lands second merges `main` and re-measures the row.
